chapters.reason: The paper uses discrete diffusion modeling on sequences, aligning closely with Masked Diffusion Models as a diffusion-based approach for sequence reasoning.
MGDM is a diffusion-based method; though it may not explicitly describe AR-diffusion hybrids, it pertains to diffusion model categories and their integration with planning tasks.
Demonstrates applications and capabilities of diffusion/reasoning approaches on multi-step tasks, aligning with the broader capability narrative.
